Task Instructions

In this task, you will see a sequence of single-digit numbers (0-9) appearing one at a time on the screen. Each number will be displayed for a short time, followed by a brief pause before the next number appears.

The task is to monitor the sequence and respond when you notice a pattern.

Task Rules

When you see a number that matches the number from 2 positions back, press the spacebar (or click the mouse) as quickly as possible.

Example: If you see the sequence 3 - 7 - 3, you should respond when you see the second 3 because it matches the 3 from 2 position back. A sequence like 4 - 4 is not a match, because they are immediately adjacent, so you would NOT respond.

How to Respond

When you see a number that matches the target number from n positions back, respond immediately by pressing the spacebar or clicking the mouse.

When you see a number that does NOT match, do nothing. Simply wait for the next number to appear.

Try to be both fast and accurate. Both speed and accuracy are important for this task.

Practice Session

Before the main task, you will complete a short practice session. This will help you get familiar with the task.

Are you ready to begin?

Task Overview

You will see a series of images, one at a time.

After each image, you will be asked to answer one or more questions about what you saw.

Press spacebar to continue

Instructions

Please pay close attention to each image. Answer the questions honestly and to the best of your ability.

Question Types:

For slider questions, move the slider to indicate your response on the scale.

For text questions, type your response in the text box.

For category questions, select the most appropriate option.
